lines.speaker: FASSBENDER:
lines.text: What happened ta the hair after?

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER:
lines.text: Do you know where it went?

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER:
lines.text: Has he ever told you what he did with that hair?

lines.speaker: WIEGERT:
lines.text: Do you have any of that hair at home?

lines.speaker: WIEGERT:
lines.text: Cuz you know we'll find it if you do. (Brendan nods "yes")

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER:
lines.text: And that would not be good for you. If we find you're lying or find things that you don't tell us about, I can't believe you then. If you tell me you're sorry this happened, then I won't believe you. .....

lines.speaker: BRENDAN:
lines.text: I don't got none of the hair.

lines.speaker: BRENDAN:
lines.text: I don't got none of the hair. (shakes head "no")

lines.speaker: WIEGERT:
lines.text: Don't got none of the hair. Did you get any blood on you?
